title: Late settlement of market payments
description: Settlement batch completed after the 14:00 bank cut-off; payments moved to next business day.
root_cause: Invoice approval backlog upstream delayed the settlement job past the bank cut-off.
resolution: Escalated pending approvals, ran an off-cycle settlement and added a cut-off monitor at 12:30.

title: Wire rejected for bad ABA number
description: Wire rejected by the intermediary bank: invalid ABA routing number.
root_cause: Bulk vendor import skipped ABA checksum validation.
resolution: Re-validated all imported vendors and made checksum validation mandatory in the import job.

title: Outbound ACH batch returned
description: Bank returned the outbound NACHA file with error R-BATCH: batch control total does not match entry detail count.
root_cause: Settlement engine patch changed batch grouping so the batch control count no longer matched the entry count.
resolution: Regenerated the ACH file with corrected batch control records and added a pre-transmission NACHA validation step.

title: ACH return R03 for vendor
description: Wire rejected by the intermediary bank: invalid ABA routing number.
root_cause: Vendor master bank details were updated with a mistyped ABA routing number during onboarding.
resolution: Corrected the vendor master record after call-back verification and added ABA checksum validation on edit.

title: Bank API timeout during payment run
description: Wire submissions timed out repeatedly between 16:00 and 17:00.
root_cause: Bank throttled requests because the payment run submitted in one burst instead of in batches.
resolution: Batched submissions in groups of 50 with back-off and agreed a month-end capacity window with the bank.
